# Security policy

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Parcha-ai/parcha-skills/security/advisories/new)
for issues in the skills and packaging maintained here. Do not open a public issue
for a suspected vulnerability.

Include the affected revision, reproduction steps, impact, and the smallest
redacted evidence needed to confirm the issue. Do not submit credentials,
transcripts, customer content, private databases, or raw service logs.

Recall and Tether implementations are maintained separately. Report system issues
through the private channels provided by their owners.
